summary: Iter57 P1-backlog validation. Backend pytest 20/27 PASS, 7 FAIL, 1 skipped (test_iter57_p1_backlog.py). Frontend /integrations page renders perfectly — every required data-testid (integrations-hero, integrations-curl-example, integrations-webhook-sample, integration-native-xero, integration-endpoint-/api/auth/login, integration-event-incident.created) is visible; #native/#api/#webhooks anchor jump links present; no JS errors (only benign 401s from unauthenticated /api/auth/me probe on public page). Native OAuth scaffolding works as designed — /api/oauth/status returns all 5 providers (xero, deputy, teletrac, ahpra, shopify) with configured=false; /api/oauth/{vendor}/start returns 400 'not configured' for every vendor (expected happy path — no vendor secrets in env); unknown provider → 404; status requires auth (401). Push device-tokens register/list/deregister flow works end-to-end for trial-active users (verified with trades.demo). HOWEVER: 5 critical P1 issues found — see action_items.

critical.issue: MISSING (404). IndustryAlertTile.jsx 'Pause driver' button calls this but no route is mounted in any router.
MISSING (404). IndustryAlertTile.jsx 'Send AHPRA reminder' button calls this but no route exists.
MISSING (404). IndustryAlertTile.jsx (TradesBody) 'Remind worker' button calls this but no route exists.
MISSING (404). IndustryAlertTile.jsx (RetailBody) 'Acknowledge check-in' button calls this — no route in retail.py (only /checkin, /escalate, /active, /logs).

Schema mismatch — backend requires {equipment, temp_c} but IndustryAlertTile.jsx posts {unit_name, temp_c} → 400 'equipment and temp_c are required'. Inline 'Log temp' tile button is broken end-to-end.

Returns 402 trial_expired for any user whose trial has ended (e.g. owner@safetradie.demo). Mobile push registration MUST work for paid + free-tier + expired-trial users. Same trial_gate allowlist pattern as Iter50 a11y/concierge fix — add '/api/device-tokens/' to _TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES in server.py.

Transport widget returns empty arrays (approaching=[], exceeding=[]) — seed_widget_demo's driver_work_diary entries fall outside the 24h trailing window the widget queries (started_at < now-24h). Either re-seed with current timestamps or change the window/use rolling cycle hours. Currently the transport dashboard tile will look empty in prod.

minor.issue: Review request referred to /api/push/register & /api/push/deregister but implementation uses /api/device-tokens/register (POST) and DELETE /api/device-tokens/{token_id}. Frontend mobile clients should use the device-tokens paths; spec wording in PRD should be updated.

integration_issues.issue: 4/5 inline-action buttons inside IndustryAlertTile.jsx are wired to backend endpoints that don't exist (404). The hospitality temp-log button is wired but posts the wrong field name ('unit_name' vs backend 'equipment'). Net effect: none of the Industry Alert Tile inline actions actually work in production.

action_items: CRITICAL — Implement the 4 missing inline-action endpoints used by IndustryAlertTile.jsx: POST /api/transport/drivers/{driver_id}/pause, POST /api/healthcare/ahpra-register/{clinician_id}/remind, POST /api/licences/{licence_id}/remind, POST /api/retail/lone-worker/{shift_id}/acknowledge. Each should write to its existing collection and (where applicable) fire push_notification + log_audit. Resend dispatch can stay mocked.

CRITICAL — Fix hospitality temp-log schema mismatch. Either: (a) change IndustryAlertTile.jsx HospitalityBody (line 446) to post {equipment: unit.name, equipment_type: unit.unit_type, temp_c}, OR (b) make backend POST /api/hospitality/temperature-logs accept either 'equipment' or 'unit_name'. Recommend (a) so payloads stay consistent.

CRITICAL — Add '/api/device-tokens/' (and ideally '/api/push/') to _TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES in server.py — mobile push registration must work even for expired-trial users (it's how we re-engage them).

HIGH — Re-run `python -m seed_widget_demo` OR rework seed_widget_demo.py so the transport driver_work_diary rows use timestamps within the last 24 hours (currently rolling out of the widget's window).
MINOR — Update the P1 spec/docs to reflect actual push paths: /api/device-tokens/register (POST) and /api/device-tokens/{token_id} (DELETE), not /api/push/*.
critical_code_review_comments: trial_gate middleware once again caught a new feature (device-tokens) by surprise. As suggested in Iter50, invert the model: gate-by-decorator on business-data writes, instead of allowlisting every cross-cutting concern (a11y, concierge, push, possibly mobile sync). Otherwise this pattern will keep recurring.
IndustryAlertTile.jsx → server contract is implicit. Add an integration smoke-test (this iter57 test file is a start) that runs in CI so missing-endpoint regressions get caught before ship.

native_oauth.py is well-structured (provider registry, configured-flag, state TTL) — the configured=false UX is clean. One nit: PROVIDERS['ahpra'] uses a non-existent AHPRA OAuth URL — fine as a placeholder, but consider gating ahpra behind a 'private_partner' flag the UI checks before showing 'Connect'.

push_notifications.py — solid stub + dispatch fan-out + auto-deactivate on provider rejection. _send_via_provider currently always returns True even when PUSH_PROVIDER is set but unwired (returns True with a warning) — should return False so the calling code marks the token inactive instead of silently 'succeeding'.

dashboard_widgets.py — fatigue widget reads `started_at` as ISO string and uses a 24h cutoff, but seed data needs to be live. Consider a relative-time seed or a longer window so the demo always shows data.
device-tokens collection is missing an index on (user_id, active) and a unique index on token — would speed up dispatch_to_devices and prevent duplicate token rows if upserts race.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — /integrations renders all required test-ids cleanly with no JS errors

test_credentials: owner@safetradie.demo / Demo@1234 (trial-expired in this env, blocks any trial-gated write); trades.demo / hospitality.demo / transport.demo / healthcare.demo / retail.demo @safebase.com.au / Demo@1234 (trial-active per-industry demos used for widgets + inline actions).
seed_data_creation: Did NOT re-run seed_widget_demo (per instructions). Note transport.demo driver_work_diary entries are now stale — widget returns empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /integrations frontend page and Native OAuth scaffolding are DONE. Push device-tokens work for trial-active users but trip the trial_gate for expired-trial users — fix is one line (add '/api/device-tokens/' to _TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES). The biggest gap is that 4/5 IndustryAlertTile inline-action endpoints don't exist in the backend at all (404) and the 5th (hospitality temp-log) has a payload schema mismatch. Re-run test_iter57_p1_backlog.py after E1 implements the missing endpoints — the test already auto-fetches IDs from the widget responses so no fixture changes needed. The transport widget will also need a fresh seed run.
rca of the issue: RCA — Industry Alert Tile inline actions: IndustryAlertTile.jsx was implemented assuming 5 backend endpoints exist (pause-driver, ahpra-remind, licence-remind, lone-worker-acknowledge, hospitality temp-log), but only 1 of the 5 (temperature-logs) has a backend route, and that one has a divergent payload contract (frontend sends unit_name+temp_c, backend expects equipment+temp_c). Reproduction: log in as each industry demo, fetch /api/dashboard/widget/{...} to grab an ID, POST the corresponding action endpoint → 404 for 4/5, 400 for 1/5. Mitigation: implement the missing routes (each is a thin DB update + audit + optional email/push) and align temp-log payload field name. Push 402 RCA: trial_gate middleware in server.py blocks all writes for users whose trial has ended; /api/device-tokens/ was never added to _TRIAL_ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES so push registration fails for expired-trial users (e.g. owner@safetradie.demo). Same fix shape as Iter50 — append '/api/device-tokens/' (and ideally '/api/push/') to the prefix tuple.
